lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The counterparty field resolves. It returns a name, and then it returns nothing else at all.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Continuity Holdings. No registered address. No department code. No staff record, no contact, no floor in any building in any Enclave on this coast.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Every counterparty has an address. That is not a convention, it is a field validation — the system will not accept a payment instruction without one. This one has been accepted two hundred and eighty times.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You file the standard resolution query, the one every auditor files forty times a quarter. It comes back accepted. Then it comes back nothing.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Four times tonight I have asked this shell a question it would not answer. In eleven years before tonight, none.
